title: Non--tautological cycles on Prym moduli spaces
summary: We denote by $\mathcal{R}_{g;m}$ the moduli space of $m$--pointed Prym curves of genus $g$, that is, tuples $[\widetilde C / C; x_1, \dots, x_m]$ where $[C, x_1, \dots, x_m]$ is an $m$--pointed curve of genus $g$ and $\widetilde C/ C$ is an étale double cover of $C$. In this paper, we address the problem of the non--tautology of the Chow ring of $\mathcal{R}_{g;m}$.
